words: Try writing down what you meant, then what the other person actually received. Two different sentences. The second one is the only one anyone can mend.
why: It shows the gap between intention and effect as a small act anyone can try, and adds the idea that only the received version can be repaired, which the Short never says up front.
transcriptTest: It names a concrete, checkable moment, when a reply lands differently than intended, and gives a two-step exercise an agent can run on its own output (what I meant versus what the user plausibly received, then repair the received version), with no body or imagery needed.
